published_ranges._nozzle_single: 190 (printed as '± 190° C', a single value, not a range)
published_ranges._notes: Brass-filled PLA; the official Formfutura page says 'Very high brass-filling of +/-60% (gravimetrically)', while the older Formfutura TDS (pdf.directindustry.com copy) says 'approximately 70% of gravimetric brass filling' (resellers copying that older text quote 2.78 g/cc). Density 3.5 g/cc is outside the validator range, so it is not in fields. Nozzle temp is a single value, so it is not put in the range fields. Abrasive: use a hardened nozzle. Bambu parent not confirmed.
